message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise‑complaint in Atlanta.**  
In the United States, “local council” refers to the city’s elected body (the City Council), but the day‑to‑day enforcement of noise ordinances is handled by the city’s police department and code‑enforcement office. Here’s how you can get it done:

| Step | What to do | Where to go / How to contact |
|------|------------|------------------------------|
| **1. Identify the problem** | Note the time, location, and nature of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). | — |
| **2. Call 311** | Atlanta’s non‑emergency municipal hotline. 311 will route your call to the appropriate department (Police, Code Enforcement, or Parks & Recreation). | Phone: **(404) 656‑3111** (or dial 311 from any Atlanta cell phone) |
| **3. File an online complaint** | Use the City of Atlanta’s 311 online portal to submit a written complaint. You’ll receive a reference number and a copy of the complaint via email. | Web: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| **4. Contact the Police Department (if urgent)** | For immediate disturbances or safety concerns, call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line. | Phone: **(404) 656‑3111** (same as 311) |
| **5. Contact Code Enforcement** | If the issue involves building code violations, construction noise, or other regulatory matters, you can file a complaint directly with the Code Enforcement office. | Phone: **(404) 656‑3111** (same as 311) |
| **6. Follow up** | Keep the reference number handy. If you don’t hear back within a few days, call 311 again and ask for an update. | — |

### Quick Reference

| Agency | Phone | Online |
|--------|-------|--------|
| City of Atlanta 311 | (404) 656‑3111 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| Atlanta Police Department (non‑emergency) | (404) 656‑3111 | Same as 311 |
| City of Atlanta Code Enforcement | (404) 656‑3111 | Same as 311 |

### Why the City Council Isn’t the First Stop

- **City Council**: Sets ordinances and policies, but does not handle individual complaints.
- **Police & Code Enforcement**: Enforce the ordinances and investigate complaints.

If you’re dealing with a recurring problem that isn’t resolved after a single complaint, you can bring it to the attention of your local City Council member. Most council members have constituent services offices that can help mediate or advocate on your behalf.

---

**Bottom line:** Call or text 311, or file an online complaint through the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal. That’s the fastest way to get a noise complaint processed and acted upon.
